profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at SmugMug
profile.summary: Software Engineer always looking for a challenge. Focused primarily in front-end web development, but interested in all aspects of software engineering. From embedded systems, to complex CSS transitions I look forward to any challenge and tackling it with whatever tools are at my disposal.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
positions.description: Co-led an effort to modernize an aging e-commerce platform with a focus on RESTful API's and mobile friendly user experiences written in PHP, ES6, React and other modern tools. Lead a team of engineers focused in e-commerce, through various projects from modernizing purchase experiences to introducing new print product flows. These efforts required constant collaboration with both design and product teams, as well as project planning and management to keep stakeholders up to date and aware of any challenges that appeared.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Focused on building customer focused features and components using modern development tools like React, Redux, Grunt, LESS and NodeJS. Day to day responsibilities varied from troubleshooting full stack bugs and issues, building reusable components in React/Redux, or working to improve the developer team's tools and technology stack.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer Intern
positions.description: Quality Assurance Engineering dealing with Selnium Based automation and internal web development

projects.title: MapOverlap
projects.description:
You go to a location (a park, campus, mall, zoo, etc), and there is no information on any map application that you have on your phone. You have access to paper maps at the venue, but you can't see your location (like on a phone's GPS) for easy navigation.

MapOverlap is an iOS app built using Swift that allows you to take a picture of a low-tech map and bring it onto your phone. You overlay the picture on top of the venue in Apple Maps, and then you can see the best of both worlds: the GPS and other information from Apple Maps, and the information from the map made by the owners of the venue (not available in Apple Maps).

projects.title: SortingHat
projects.description: An app that allows for teachers to create teams based on a survey they create through the app. The app will do the team creation but will also allow for post-sorting creation in case the teacher does not agree with the outcome.
